context: M28 escort leg 1: Corwin to Broadway & W 32nd. Marchers fall in behind.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: I came up from Savannah in twenty-nine. Walked this street looking for work.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Thirty years washing sheets at the Pennsylvania. Never once walked in the front door.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Today you're walking down the middle of Broadway, Mrs. Pruitt.

lines.speaker: char.odessa_pruitt
lines.text: Slowly, Mr. Arce. Slowly. Let them see the hat.
